_comment: Published industry-standard dimensions. These are NOT estimates and NOT
inferred from product names - each entry names the specification it comes
from so a reviewer can check it.
Why this file exists: for six of the eight component categories the fit-critical
number is fixed by a published standard, so there is nothing to guess and
nothing to scrape. Motherboard size IS the form factor. A PSU envelope IS the
ATX/SFX spec. Storage IS M.2 2280 or 2.5 inch. Guessing those would be both
What is deliberately NOT here: per-model values. GPU length, CPU cooler height,
case clearance and RAM heatspreader height differ per SKU and must come from the
manufacturer's own specification for that exact model. There is no standard to
fall back on, and inventing one is the failure this project keeps getting wrong.
key            the value written into components.specs
source         the published specification it comes from
confidence     'standard' = fixed by a spec; 'varies' = per-model, absent here

motherboard_forms._source: Intel ATX Design Guide / MicroATX and Mini-ITX form factor specifications; AMD socket form factors
motherboard_forms._note: Width x Depth. A motherboard's form factor literally IS its size, so this is derivable rather than looked up.

psu_envelopes._source: Intel ATX Power Supply Design Guide; SFX12V specification
psu_envelopes._note: W x H x D envelope is fixed by the standard. LENGTH is per-model and is deliberately absent - that is the fit-critical number and varies widely across otherwise identical PSUs.

atx.label: ATX
atx.source: Intel ATX Power Supply Design Guide

ram_modules._source: JEDEC DDR DIMM and SO-DIMM specifications
ram_modules._note: Length and PCB height are standard. HEATSPREADER height is NOT - it varies from roughly 31mm to 45mm across kits and is the number that decides whether a cooler overhangs the first DIMM slot. Left absent on purpose.

storage_devices._source: NVMe M.2 and SFF/ATA device form factor specifications
storage_devices._note: Fixed by the device form factor, which is why storage can be closed out as standard shapes.

bays.note: Drive bay counts are a case property and are per-model; only the device sizes above are standard.

_varies_per_model._why: No published standard fixes these. They differ per SKU from the same manufacturer, so they can only come from that model's own specification sheet. Source them, do not infer them.
